question: how many invoices are partially paid?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT b.id, b.due_date, b.customer_id, SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id=b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE','PAYABLE','CASH','BANK') AND j.debit>0),0) AS paid FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' GROUP BY b.id, b.due_date, b.customer_id) x WHERE x.paid > 0.01 AND x.amt-x.paid > 0.01
agent_sql_scrubbed:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
FROM (
  SELECT b.id,
         SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity - COALESCE(bi.discount,0)) * (1 + COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id = j.account_id
                   WHERE j.bill_id = b.id AND j.debit > 0
                   AND a.account_type IN (?,?,?,?)), 0) AS paid
  FROM bills b
  JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id = b.id
  WHERE b.type = ?
  GROUP BY b.id
) x
WHERE x.paid > 0.01 AND ABS(x.amt - x.paid) > 0.01;
